reason: The first eight proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment, so they are one experiment repeated under different IDs; test one representative first and do not treat the duplicates as independent evidence. It has verified helper ABI and panel correctness, but no full-GEMM performance result. The B-panel proposal adds a 1 MiB pack and changes the B layout seen by a no-transpose helper whose compatibility is unresolved, so verify correctness before measuring it. Tail alignment affects only the general-size fallback, not the n=512 timed path.
